mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1200K units, indicating strong demand, boosts consumer discretionary spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 1200K.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.5% signals accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days, as investors seek higher yields.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment (UNRATE) drops below 4.2% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) grows by > 200K in a month, the combined labor market strength predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly higher (t-test p > 0.1) in triggered instances vs. baseline over 2 years.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) growth above 5% YoY signals strong supply chain activity, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Real disposable personal income (RSAFS) growth below -2% YoY indicates weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) rises above 2% and CPI (CPIAUCSL) growth exceeds 3% YoY, the combined monetary and inflationary pressure predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly lower (t-test p > 0.05) in triggered instances vs. baseline over 1.5 years.

mechanism_narrative: GDP (GDPC1) growth above 4% QoQ indicates strong aggregate demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days, as businesses expand to meet growing consumption.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.025 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4.5% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) growth is positive for 3 consecutive months, the sustained labor market strength predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days, but only during mid-cycle expansions.
failure_condition: SPX returns in triggered mid-cycle instances are not significantly higher (t-test p > 0.1) than in other regimes over 2 years.
